title: Notebook types
description: Kinds of notebook (data/notebook-types.json): how a new notebook's scans become pages and how its pages are read.

label.description: As shown in the Import form.

pages.description: Pages per scan: 2 for spreads, 1 for single sheets.

rotate.description: Clockwise degrees that make a scan upright.

split.description: Where a spread's fold usually is, as a share of its upright width.

numbering.description: odd-printed-right: odd numbers printed on right-hand pages, even ones inferred.

form.description: stamped: the rubber-stamped log form; free: free text, a session starting at a date heading (#109).
